comparison_targets: RP-7134 / STRAT-SPEC-0003 z-score trend-gated mean reversion

proposed_mechanics.anchor: Rolling candle-VWAP approximation from high/low/close/volume over 96 or 192 bars.
proposed_mechanics.trigger: ATR-normalized distance from rolling VWAP with RSI exhaustion confirmation.
proposed_mechanics.gate: RSI extreme threshold plus fixed min_bars_between_entries=8; no SMA trend gate is proposed.
proposed_mechanics.normalization: ATR distance threshold, not SMA/stddev z-score normalization.
proposed_mechanics.entry_logic: Both-direction mean-reversion entries when price is sufficiently far from rolling VWAP and RSI is extreme.
proposed_mechanics.exit_or_risk_logic: Return to VWAP or RSI neutral exit; no SMA centerline exit is proposed.

concluded_family_mechanics.anchor: SMA centerline with STDDEV scale inside a z_score composed operand.
concluded_family_mechanics.trigger: Long when close is below SMA by more than 1.5 rolling standard deviations; short when close is above SMA by more than 1.5 rolling standard deviations.
concluded_family_mechanics.gate: Shared trend gate requiring close above SMA(trend_lookback_bars); fixed min_bars_between_entries=8.
concluded_family_mechanics.normalization: z_score using close, SMA center, and STDDEV scale.
concluded_family_mechanics.entry_logic: Both-direction z-score overextension fade through SMA/stddev composed operand.
concluded_family_mechanics.exit_or_risk_logic: Side-specific SMA centerline exits; no max holding period.

concluded_family_mechanics.anchor: SMA/stddev overextension formalized into the STRAT-SPEC-0003 capability family.
concluded_family_mechanics.trigger: Fixed plus/minus 1.5 z-score entries under the available adapter.
concluded_family_mechanics.gate: Shared SMA trend gate and 8-bar entry throttle copied from STRAT-SPEC-0003.

mechanical_differences: The proposed anchor is rolling VWAP from OHLCV high/low/close/volume, not SMA close-only centerline.
The proposed scale is ATR distance, not standard-deviation z-score.
The proposed confirmation gate is RSI exhaustion, not shared SMA trend gating.
The proposed exit is return to VWAP or RSI neutral, not SMA centerline crossing.
The proposed denominator axes are rolling_vwap_lookback_bars, distance_atr_entry, and rsi_extreme, not center_lookback_bars, vol_lookback_bars, and trend_lookback_bars.
mechanical_overlaps: Both HYP-003R and RP-7134 are 15m both-direction mean-reversion ideas.
Both use normalized distance from a rolling reference anchor.
Both require existing OHLCV-derived indicator support and fixed entry throttling.
load_bearing_fresh_elements: rolling_vwap_lookback_bars is an explicit denominator axis and changes the reference anchor.
distance_atr_entry uses ATR-normalized distance and changes the scale.
rsi_extreme is an explicit denominator axis and changes the trigger confirmation.
return_to_vwap_or_rsi_neutral changes exit semantics from SMA centerline exits.
cosmetic_elements: The phrase distance reversion overlaps with prior fade-family language.
Using a rolling reference alone is not distinct; the distinctness depends on keeping VWAP/ATR/RSI rather than SMA/stddev.
reason: The proposed mechanics do not reduce to the committed SMA/stddev z-score family as written: anchor, scale, trigger confirmation, exit, and denominator axes differ. Collapse risk remains medium because a future formalizer that cannot express rolling VWAP, ATR distance, RSI, or VWAP/RSI exits could regress into the already-blocked SMA/stddev adapter path.
